title: Understanding Model Risk
text: Model risk is the sum of model variance and observational variance. Can you calculate the model risk for the new model using the given variances?

title: Model Variance and Features
text: Adding more features to a model can affect its variance. Think about how increasing the complexity of a model might change its variance.

title: Calculate New Model Risk
text: Given the model variance of $$10$$ and observational variance of $$3$$, what is the new model risk?

hintAnswer: The model becomes more complex, capturing more noise.
title: Impact of Features on Variance
text: If adding features increases the model variance, which of the following could be a reason?
choices: The model becomes more complex, capturing more noise.
The model becomes simpler, reducing noise.
The model variance is unaffected by features.
